blocks.text:
You can use C APIs which do not yet have convenient C++ interfaces.
It is generally not a problem to use C APIs from C++, and gtkmm helps by
providing access to the underlying C object, and providing an easy way to create
a C++ wrapper object from a C object, provided that the C API is also based on
the `GObject` system.
blocks.zh: 那些还没有顺手 C++ 接口的 C API 也可以用。在 C++ 里调用 C API 一般不成问题； gtkmm 还帮了两把：让你能访问底层的 C 对象，并且在 C API 同样基于 GObject 系统的前提下，提供从 C 对象便捷创建 C++ 包装对象的途径。

blocks.text:
The C++ wrapper shall be explicitly deleted if

it's a widget or other class that inherits from `Gtk::Object`, and
the C instance has a floating reference when the wrapper is created, and
`Gtk::manage()` has not been called on it (which includes if it was created with `Gtk::make_managed()`), or
`Gtk::manage()` was called on it, but it was never added to a parent.

`Glib::wrap()` binds the C and C++ instances to each other.
Don't delete the C++ instance before you want the C instance to die.
blocks.zh: C++ 包装对象在满足以下条件时必须显式删除：

blocks.text: it's a widget or other class that inherits from Gtk::Object, and
blocks.zh: 它是控件或别的继承自 Gtk::Object 的类，且

blocks.text: the C instance has a floating reference when the wrapper is created, and
blocks.zh: 创建包装对象时 C 实例带 floating reference（浮动引用），且

blocks.text: Gtk::manage() has not been called on it (which includes if it was created with Gtk::make_managed()), or
blocks.zh: 没有对它调用过 Gtk::manage()（包括用 Gtk::make_managed() 创建的情况），或者

blocks.text: Gtk::manage() was called on it, but it was never added to a parent.
blocks.zh: 调用过 Gtk::manage()，但从未把它加进任何父容器。

blocks.text:
In all other cases the C++ instance is automatically deleted when the last reference
to the C instance is dropped. This includes all `Glib::wrap()`
overloads that return a `Glib::RefPtr`.
blocks.zh: Glib::wrap() 把 C 实例和 C++ 实例绑定在一起：不希望 C 实例死掉之前，别删 C++ 实例。
